Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE initial adult NPC standing sprite for a classic top-down Unity pixel RPG, for design approval only. Reference image1 is Yuuki CHILD, used ONLY for the game's detailed shaded pixel-art rendering, clean readable outlines, feather/fabric texture and slightly elevated camera; DO NOT copy her child age, tiny child body, white hair, dress, bow, red eyes or asymmetric wings. Create a distinct ADULT PARENT, young adult face despite mild working-day fatigue, kind and grounded. Adult stylized game proportions about3.5heads tall, clearly taller and more mature than reference child, no photorealism, no flat vector icon. Modest clean inexpensive everyday clothes, cared for despite slight wear; a poor hardworking angel from a lived-in suburban neighborhood, not a beggar, noble, armored hero or ragged caricature. TWO normal WHITE feathered wings folded behind shoulders, one per side, both entirely visible and contained, no black feathers. ONE full body standing in a neutral relaxed pose, almost FRONT with very slight three-quarter turn, both eyes readable, arms relaxed at sides, empty hands and both feet planted. Consistent classic RPG pixel-art light from upper-left, subtle dimensional shading. Full scalp, long hair ends, both wing tips, hands and both shoes inside frame. Centered isolated character with ample true transparent margins, preferably square. No weapon, staff, tool, jewelry, halo, scenery, floor/shadow, text, label, watermark, panel or extra pose. Halo will be a separate asset. Crisp pixels, no blurring, no distorted hands or elongated legs.
